messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — customer Jane reports sudden 403s from embeddings after they completed SSO provisioning earlier today. They say text-generation still works but embeddings endpoint returns: 

  HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
  { "error": "insufficient_scope", "message": "missing:embeddings" }

  She rotated and provisioned via Okta -> our provisioner. Can someone help triage?

Alex (Platform): Thanks Maria. Can you paste a repro request + the token introspection response (if they have it)?

Maria (CS): Pasting the minimal repro from the customer:

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"hello"}'

  Result: 403 as above.

  They also ran our token introspect endpoint and sent this body:

  {
    "active": true,
    "client_id": "svc-acct-123",
    "sub": "svc-acct-123@okta",
    "permissions": ["inference","rerank","embeddings"],
    "exp": 1710000000
  }

  Note: scopes field is missing — the provisioner injected a `permissions` claim (array) instead of `scope` (string).

Jon (Eng): Interesting — our auth check currently expects either a space-delimited `scope` claim string or `scp` claim variants. We don't look at a `permissions` array. That would explain why generation still works: the generation API uses a fallback that accepts `inference` from other checks, but embeddings enforces explicit `embeddings` scope.

Alex (Platform): Any recent changes in the provisioner mapping? @provisioner-bot, did the Okta import handler switch to normalize into `permissions`?

provisioner-bot: Deploy ID 2026-03-16-19:12:12 — mapping change: okta->token claims mapping: use JSON array for grants when provider reports structured entitlements. Rollout: canary -> 100% at 19:10 UTC.

Maria (CS): Customer rotated at 19:20 UTC so they likely hit the new behavior. They can't roll back Okta. Asking for mitigation so their prod app is unblocked.

Jon (Eng): Short-term options:
  - Have customer request a dedicated API key from Console (bypass SSO token mapping).
  - OR we can add a temporary auth compatibility check to accept `permissions` arrays. I can put a small guard in the token parsing path to merge permissions -> scope string. Will take ~1-2 hours to patch + rollout to edge.

Alex (Platform): Long-term: update provisioner config to write `scope` (space-delimited string) as well as `permissions` array, or update Okta mapping docs. Also add an automated test asserting embeddings requires `embeddings`.

Maria (CS): Customer prefers we flip a compatibility patch so they don't have to redeploy. Jane: are you ok with us touching the auth edge for a hotfix?

Jane (Customer): Yes please — we can't delay. Repro window is open.

Jon (Eng): I'll open a hotfix PR in 10m. PR will:
  - on token parse, if `scope` missing and `permissions` is array, set scope = permissions.join(' ')
  - add unit test and a quick integration smoke in staging

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch fix/permissions-compat. Build 4456 queued.

Maria (CS): Thanks. Please ping when done and I will tell customer to retest. Also adding a follow-up to docs to avoid this in future.

Jon (Eng): Patch merged, rolling to staging now. ETA to prod ~35m after CI + canary.

deploy-bot: Deployment to edge-canary succeeded. Rollout: 10% -> monitoring for errors for 15m.

Alex (Platform): I'll follow up to update the provisioner mapping so new tokens include both `scope` and `permissions` claims. Also adding a migration playbook: if providers supply structured entitlements, provisioner should write legacy `scope` for backward compatibility.

Maria (CS): Jane — can you try again?

Jane (Customer): Re-tested. Embeddings call now returns 200 and vectors. THANK YOU :tada:

Maria (CS): Closing the ticket once we confirm customer stability for 24h. Action items:
  - (Platform) Update provisioner mapping and docs — Alex
  - (Eng) Monitor for any other providers emitting `permissions` arrays and add parsers — Jon
  - (CS) Confirm with customer in 24h and offer help rotating to new token if needed — Maria

Alex (Platform): Noted. I'll schedule a small migration change this week and add a release note.

Jon (Eng): Logged follow-up GH issues: #12458 (auth: accept permissions array), #12459 (provisioner: include legacy scope).

Maria (CS): Thanks everyone :heart:
